text_block_list.text:
With her debut race behind us, I discussed 
our next target race with Satono Diamond.

"To become a distinguished Umamusume 
capable of winning a G1 race." Considering 
her goal, a Junior-class G1 race seems 
appropriate, but—
choice_data_list:
Do you have any preferences for your next 
race?

Do you have any preferences for your next 
race?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to challenge the Classic Triple 
Crown.
choice_data_list: You mean not a Junior G1 race?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course, winning a GⅠ is one of our 
goals, but it is merely one step along the 
path.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What the Satono family considers a 
"legendary Umamusume" is one who supports 
the advancement of the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
As you know, the Satono family has always 
wished to contribute to the Umamusume 
world, supporting operations and engaging 
in charity work.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Producing 'a distinguished Umamusume 
capable of winning a G1' is also a 
contribution to supporting the Umamusume 
world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is to become someone who supports 
the Umamusume world and racing culture 
from within."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I felt we ought to take the 
royal road. Enlivening the Classic Triple 
Crown would also serve as a contribution 
to the world of Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"And if possible, I would like to head 
into the Satsuki Sho in peak condition."
choice_data_list: Is our next goal the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.text:
If we truly want her in peak condition, 
instead of Junior Class races, it might be 
better to target the Satsuki Sho from the 
get-go.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. How does this look?

There was no particular reason to object. 
Winning the Classic Triple Crown 
inherently meant achieving G1 victories as 
well. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Is something the matter? You are 
staring quite intently at my face.
choice_data_list: I was thinking how unwavering you are

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
About my goal? It is the reason I was 
born. There is no room for doubt.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, I haven't properly 
explained why my parents and I are so 
fixated on becoming a renowned Umamusume, 
have I?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
As I mentioned earlier, while our family 
has passionately contributed to the 
development of the Umamusume world, we 
have yet to produce a truly legendary 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
None of the Satono Umamusume who have run 
up until now have been able to win a GⅠ 
race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
At some point, people began calling it the 
"Satono Jinx."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, for a long period, only boys 
were born, and there was a time when no 
Umamusume came into the family...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whispers began to spread that the lack of 
Umamusume born into the clan might also be 
due to the jinx.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am the Umamusume born having broken that 
jinx—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was born to make the dreams of the 
Satono family come true.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Since my parents held central positions 
within the group, I have received a great 
deal of support since I was young.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It is thanks to the expectations of 
everyone in my family that I am who I am 
today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —It is what supports me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I want to live up to my 
family's expectations. That is my dream! I 
will never waver!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even the jinx that no Satono Umamusume can 
win a G1— I can break it—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I will win the Classic Triple Crown and 
prove it!
choice_data_list:
Got it. Let's aim for the Classic Triple 
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! In that case, the 
Satsuki Sho comes first.

If we're heading for the Classic Triple 
Crown route, we'll also need a game plan 
for the Japan Derby and Kikuka Sho, both 
of which are longer than the Satsuki Sho.

If we start now, we can take our time. 
Keeping future races in mind, let's adjust 
our conditioning toward next year's 
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Warm-ups are finished. The first menu 
item is...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahhh!! Dia-chan, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What's wrong, Kita-chan? Running 
around in such a panic...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You know, I watched it! Dia-chan's debut 
race!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't go in person, but I saw the 
broadcast! I was sooo, sooooo excited!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We all watched it together on the big TV 
in the dorm! I couldn't help but shout 
out, 'Go get 'em, Dia-chan!' and cheer for 
you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone scolded me for being way too 
loud.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Even so, it was such a nail-biting race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's so like you, Kita-chan. 
Thanks for cheering me on!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's, like... a different kind of joy from 
my own debut race. It got me so excited!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The look on Dia-chan's face as she ran was 
different from during school mock races 
and training together...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it made me truly realize... that 
she's reached the same place as me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations on your debut, 
Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Sorry to keep you waiting... 
Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, knowing Dia-chan is chasing after 
me, I can't afford to slack off either!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I missed out on the Satsuki Sho and the 
Japanese Derby, but I'm definitely winning 
the next one, the Kikuka Sho!!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
As Dia-chan's big sister figure, I've 
gotta secure a GⅠ victory first!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My next goal is the Classic Triple Crown 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Is that true!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's why I'll be taking notes on 
how Kita-chan runs in the Kikuka-sho.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh! Now I really can't afford to lose! 
I don't wanna be a bad role model!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading back to training! See ya, 
Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best in my own race! Just wait 
for me a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Got it! Let's both do our best!

Kitasan Black left like a whirlwind. Just 
talking to her somehow fills me with 
energy.
choice_data_list:
If I recall... you promised to run 
together, right?

If I recall... you promised to run 
together, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, when we were little. We promised each 
other that we'd run together forever.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan was the first girl of my 
generation who was 'stronger' than me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And after we became friends... Kita-chan 
took me, knowing nothing of the outside 
world, to all sorts of places.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've been chasing after Kita-chan running 
ahead of me... All this time, endlessly 
chasing her...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've always held the constant desire to 
catch up and overtake them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan is my friend, and also someone I 
want to beat.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Kita-chan is incredible. She has 
a kind of toughness that I lack... sheer 
grit, maybe?
choice_data_list: I feel like I kind of get it...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, isn't it? Though unfortunately I 
lost both the Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo 
Yushun (Japanese Derby)...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"That's Kita-chan for you—she never gives 
up. I'd say the real match is just getting 
started!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"So I can't afford to take it easy either. 
I will claim victory in the 'Satsuki Sho', 
without fail!"

Having Kitasan Black as the rival she 
wants to beat makes Satono Diamond 
stronger— Listening to her, I felt certain 
of it.
